facts.fact: internal/llmprompts holds every LLM prompt and LLM-facing instruction both apps send; distinct from internal/prompts, the P246 popup router.

registry.go only file containing prompt text; user-authored text (smart-script bodies, workflow stage and step prompts), tool and server names, tool error strings, result data formatting stay out of registry.

Prompt kinds: system, message, suffix, instructions, tool, argument, toolResult, fragment. argument is one MCP tool property description with Parent tool and Field; fragment included via {{template}}.
InputSchema[T] sets each tool property's description from its argument entry; mismatch panics at server build; jsonschema tags not used.
Prompt templates use text/template, one set per resolve, only funcs inc and join; entry with NoVars and no fragments is literal, never parsed.
Default prompts render byte-identical to pre-P271 output, checked against testdata/golden.
RenderParts wraps each string variable in marker runes and splits so Settings Preview can mark resolved values with VarText; failed self-check returns one literal part.

Prompt overrides stored per app in <home>/llm-prompts.json (~/.kira-studio/, ~/.kira-space/), written with renameio at mode 0600, shaped {version, revision, overrides: {id: {text, defaultHash, updatedAt}}}.

Saving prompt's default text removes its override. Override text must be 1 byte to 32 KiB, template must parse, every prompt:"required" variable and required fragment must be present, execution against example vars must succeed.
Prompt change carries baseHash; stale change refused with E_CONFLICT.
If prompt store file corrupt or override no longer validates, default used, warning logged, Settings flags it (storeError, invalid); defaultChanged flags override made against older default.
memory.dataHygiene fragment required in memory system prompts as injection defence.
Schema-bound prompts (gate, reconcile, import extract and finalize) keep JSON schema fixed, shown read-only in Settings.

No global prompt source; consumers receive llmprompts.Source (Resolve, Revision) through options; Defaults() is registry-only source. Store.Resolve stats file per call, re-reads when mtime or size changes.

Gate, reconcile, import, headless suffixes and ADE messages resolve per call, so edits apply next call; dbmcp and claudeheadless rebuild MCP server on Revision() change; stdio subprocess memory-mcp builds descriptions once per process, so edits reach only new Claude sessions.
LlmPromptsService (List, Save, Preview) exists in both apps, emits event kira:llmPrompts:changed with {revision}; Save all-or-nothing, per-id errors returned as E_BAD_REQUEST payload.
Preview with real vars also renders ADE run dialog and step inspector, so no TypeScript copy of a prompt exists.

Settings has Prompts section before Advanced in both apps: list, Monaco editor, diff against default, Preview, per-entry reset; drafts live in Pinia store llmPromptDrafts; dialog Save saves prompts first, then settings patch.

Guard go run ./internal/llmprompts/cmd/checkprompts (part of bun run lint) fails on jsonschema tag, MCP Tool/Prompt/PromptArgument Description or mcp.ServerOptions Instructions not from llmprompts, or memory.Call System not from llmprompts.
checkprompts guard also fails on copy of registry default (first 48 characters, or whole text when 24 to 47) in non-test .go, .ts or .vue file outside internal/llmprompts and internal/flowtest.
